name: mysql
description: Query the MySQL databases you connect, as you. Your agent names a connection by its alias and runs SQL: a read runs at once, anything that changes data waits for your click on your own computer. You type each database password on a page on your own computer; the agent, the room and the logs never see it. Needs your agent to run sandboxed, unless your organization allows otherwise.

settings.label: When the agent is not sandboxed
settings.help: refuse (default): do nothing unless the agent is sandboxed. allow-with-warning: work, and warn once that the agent can read your saved passwords. Neither stops a hostile agent on the host; only the sandbox does. Borrowed agents are always refused.
